Formula Builder

✨ Build it for me

free · works offline

Type what the formula should do. You get a complete draft from your own ingredient library: exact % by weight, lb per ton, mixing order and watch-outs. Edit any line, then save.

Enter each ingredient as % by weight of the finished blend. The balance ingredient fills whatever is left up to 100%.

Analysis is calculated from standard nominal grades (or your custom entries). It is an estimate, not a label guarantee — verify with your supplier's label.
